description: Extend the upper edge of this existing broad low painted flame upward by about 20 pixels. Keep its wide rooted shape: a soft broad yellow-orange body with a few shallow rounded tapered crests, all joined continuously to the existing fire. New fire grows out from the existing orange area; do not bend, rotate or lean the original flame. Preserve exactly the soft mottled brush texture, warm orange shadows and yellow hot interior. A slightly fuller phase of the SAME low flame, still much wider than high. Keep everything connected: no sparks, dots, detached wisps, holes or isolated pieces. No tall thin horns, spikes, jets, new flame columns, bright white areas or flash. Transparent surrounding area. Only extend and redraw the existing upper contour in the permitted area.
